sentence: This project looks at medical records and other factors to find out how to better assess and document age-related risk in older adults with cancer.
This project studies infectious diseases using genomics, cell biology, immunology and gene editing, together with how the diseases spread in their natural setting.
This project tries to find out how alcohol changes the way cells move materials inside them, leading to fatty liver and liver injury.
This project provides imaging and spectroscopy instruments that let researchers study how cells and tissues use metabolism in disease, development and repair.
This project builds resources to study how opioids change nerve circuits in the brain that control motivated behavior in rodents.
This project studies how degenerative cervical myelopathy injures the spine and develops markers of ongoing injury seen through imaging.
This project screens chemical compounds to find ones that could work as contraceptives by acting on targets involved in reproduction.
This project develops an imaging probe that targets collagen to show fibrosis and the tumor in pancreatic cancer and to track response to treatment.
This project tests whether artificial intelligence early warning systems help home healthcare nurses spot older adults at risk of hospitalization before they get worse.
This project uses large linked datasets to find which modifiable multi-level factors shape outcomes and disparities in head and neck cancer.
This project studies how alcohol use and alcohol-associated liver disease can be treated together in patients with advanced liver disease.
This project makes and purifies proteins and measures their properties so researchers can study protein structure.
This project studies how viral infections of the lung, including influenza, lead to long-lasting scarring of the lungs.
This project tries to find out how dopamine and the loss of dopamine change the way nerve cells connect and adjust in the striatum.
This project uses induced pluripotent stem cells to study how Huntington's disease disrupts the development of striatal neurons.
This project builds a vaccine knowledgebase that gathers and organizes vaccine information using literature mining, machine learning tools and knowledge graphs.
This project provides statistical and bioinformatics support for cancer studies, including study design, data analysis and interpretation.
This project provides brain imaging with MRI to study processes in Alzheimer's disease and other diseases that affect brain health.
This project studies why small cell lung cancer resists a drug and tests whether adding a second drug that blocks a chromatin modifier helps.
This project develops person-specific thresholds for bone mineral density to better predict fractures in minority women.
